title: Apocalypse Clock: Global Systemic Risk Monitor
description: Apocalypse Clock is an experimental, browser-based systemic-risk dashboard for exploring interacting global threats through scenario controls, Monte Carlo uncertainty sampling, dependency-aware aggregation, Weibull horizon diagnostics, network analysis, and exportable model outputs. The project is not peer reviewed. Model outputs are scenario outputs, not predictions.
notes: Version 1.2.9 makes regime first-passage timing responsive to the existing sampled latent-pressure growth and replaces domain priority-mass dates with propagated, fixed-criticality functional horizons. Dataset v1.9.0 numerical values are unchanged. The model does not claim empirical calibration or predictive validation. Released under the custom source-available non-commercial fork license; the project is not peer reviewed and outputs remain conditional scenarios, not predictions.
